integrity: The theorem is proved analytically. Finite numerical tests are corroborative only. Literature searches and source inspections are recorded separately; absence from searches is not treated as a proof of novelty.
scientific_limitations: The result determines the sharp constant for one natural four-frequency support and supplies an attaining polynomial, but does not classify all extremizers or arbitrary four-element supports.
title: The golden-ratio Sidon constant of the symmetric four-frequency set
